subject: Fix for problems with shinyStan customization panels

messages.author: fc5d3270037d7478
messages.subject: Fix for problems with shinyStan customization panels
parts:
If you recently installed shinyStan and are having issues with the collapsible customization/options panels (e.g. they don't open and close properly, the colors make the text difficult to read, etc.) please try reinstalling the shinyBS package using the method described on the troubleshooting page of the shinyStan wiki.

The shinyBS package is important to the functionality of the shinyStan GUI but the most recent updates to shinyBS prevent the shinyStan customization panels from rendering properly. The instructions on the troubleshooting page should resolve this problem.
